blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan has denied the separate petitions for bail filed by detained Sen. Rodante Marcoleta and his three coaccused in the senator’s P75-million plunder case. Meanwhile the senator’s 90-day preventive suspension, as ordered last month by the Sandiganbayan’s Third Division, took effect on Nov. 19, according to the Senate. Republic Act No. […]...
